design: all refinement groups plus purposive full-document goal review
independence: fresh review context separate from generating agents; same model family, not human or formal proof
all_groups_review: Every refinement group in all 31 expanded documents, including proposed/partial; read parent/children, conditions, assumptions, evidence and enough original context for the actual claim.
other_goals: All goals receive author semantic self-review and deterministic checks. Non-sampled goals are independently reviewed only as refinement endpoints or if a specific risk requires it; do not claim full independent goal coverage.
sampling_rationale: Purposive spread across long/short sources and three processing batches. Not random and not an unseen accuracy test. Main comparison remains the three pilot documents.
repair: Confirmed material issues are repaired in a separate artifact revision and independently rechecked on affected objects; preserve originals and do not fabricate human feedback.

additional_review_reason.DOC015: Exact quantitative quotation contains U+00A0 and an encoding artifact; separate reported timings/prices from desired thresholds. Not selected by goal-count quality inference.
additional_review_reason.DOC012: Two interview sections exchange question/answer roles. Independently confirm actor attribution and no accidental cross-person merging.
